# Greta Rusecke — ISTQB Certified QA Specialist & AI Product Builder

> Personal portfolio of Greta Rusecke, an ISTQB Certified Tester (Foundation Level) working as a
> QA Product Engineer and AI product builder in Thessaloniki, Greece. The site is available in
> English and Greek and includes an AI assistant ("Greta AI") that answers questions about her
> career, skills and projects.

## Career summary

- IT Project Manager (2016–2018) — coordinated delivery teams, requirements and release planning.
- Manual QA Engineer (2021–2023) — functional, regression and exploratory testing; defect
  reporting and test documentation.
- QA Product Engineer (2024–2026) — end-to-end quality ownership, test strategy, release
  readiness, and AI-assisted product prototyping.

## Skills

- QA: test strategy, test case design, functional and non-functional testing, regression, smoke,
  E2E and UAT, cross-browser and cross-platform testing (Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS via BrowserStack),
  defect lifecycle, bug triage, release readiness, BrowserStack, ISTQB practices.
- AI product building: prompt engineering, Lovable AI, AI-assisted full-stack prototyping,
  shipping production-ready web apps solo, GitHub and Vercel deployment with DNS/env setup.
- Systems: SaaS, ERP, CRM and e-commerce platforms.
- Frontend & tooling: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, responsive web design, Jira, Confluence,
  Trello, Git.
- Management: requirement analysis, sprint planning, stakeholder communication, agile delivery.

## International experience

Worked with cross-functional teams and B2B clients across the USA, UK, Spain, Latvia and New Zealand.

## Projects

- Devcraft — an AI-assisted product built and shipped end to end.
- Lotus Bloom — a web product designed, built and tested solo.
- CleanUpSKG — a community-focused web application for Thessaloniki.
